circumstances: Bodaboda (motorcycle taxi) driver based in Kawe, Dar es Salaam, who became the subject of widespread missing-person appeals in August and September 2026. According to public alerts and social-media campaigns shared by his family and activists, on Saturday 1 August 2026 at around 4:00 PM, approximately five individuals arrived at his home in Kawe, identified themselves as police officers, and took him away without explaining where he was being escorted. His whereabouts remain unknown; his pregnant wife has publicly asked for help locating him. No official confirmation.
